gadgets.sink: jsreport-child-templates applyParameters: a dotted @param path is walked with `it = it[k] = it[k] || {}`, then extend(true, req, modifications)
gadgets.payload: {#child <an existing store template> @__proto__.helpers$=<base64 of a JSON string>} emitted into the RENDERED OUTPUT, which the extension re-scans
gadgets.effect: Object.prototype.helpers becomes a string in the long-lived engine process; the NEXT render resolves inputs.template.helpers to it and run()s it in the vm2 sandbox
gadgets.precondition: at least ONE template entity in the document store. Measured: a stock deploy can have none, and applyParameters runs only after a template is found.
gadgets.trap: pollute with a STRING. An array (e.g. `scripts`) makes node.extend recurse forever and every later request dies with Maximum call stack size exceeded.
gadgets.proven_by: knowledge/chains/cscv2026-chromatic-* ; measured dead on a stock diemthi deploy (knowledge/attempts/cscv2026-diemthi.json)

gadgets.sink: jsreport-core/lib/render/resolveReferences.js:30 `if (ref in byid)` -- `in` walks the prototype chain of an empty object
gadgets.payload: data = {"$id":"r","name":{"$ref":"__proto__"}}  (nested $ref resolves only when the parent carries $id)
gadgets.effect: yields Object.prototype, Object, or an Object.prototype method as a DATA value
gadgets.precondition: one hop only, so Function is not reachable; measured to print [object Object] for every ref
gadgets.trap: top-level {"$ref":"__proto__"} makes inputs.data BE Object.prototype, so the three __appDirectory writes land on it -- fixed keys, fixed values, not useful

gadgets.effect: arbitrary file read inside the jsreport container
gadgets.precondition: extensions.assets.searchOnDiskIfNotFoundInStore, which assets.js sets only when reporter.options.allowLocalFilesAccess === true. Measured OFF on a stock 2.9.0: 'Asset /etc/hostname not found'.

gadgets.sink: jsreport-core engineScript: every FUNCTION global of the safeSandbox becomes a handlebars helper, because child-templates always assigns template.helpers a string
gadgets.payload: {{require "child_process"}} / {{render x}} / {{respond a b}} from template content
gadgets.effect: require is blocked while templatingEngines.allowedModules is []; jsreport-handlebars does a HOST-side require(opts.handlebarsModulePath), so a polluted Object.prototype.handlebarsModulePath turns {{render x}} into host require() of an arbitrary path
gadgets.precondition: template CONTENT control, plus prototype pollution for the render variant
gadgets.trap: measured present: require, render, respond, setTimeout, childTemplateParseData, childTemplateSerializeData. Measured ABSENT: evalGet, evalSet, safeGet -- the xlsx helpers load only for their own recipes.
gadgets.proven_by: measured with the 'Missing helper' error as an oracle
